name: tape_echo
author: coldsoldr
description: Tape echo: a three-head tape delay (Space Echo style) at 22.05 kHz in stereo, from te-op1-cfw's fixed-point TAPE ECHO (the hundekraft kennel plugin ports/knl/tape_echo 0.2, coldsoldr, GPL-3.0-or-later), with the wow and flutter of Mutable Instruments Beads and the half-rate output stage of Clouds (Emilie Gillet, MIT). Blue time, green feedback, white age, orange mix; fn + blue input gain (0.5 dB a detent, shift + fn + blue 0.1 dB), fn + green sync (off, or the time follows a tempo division 1/16T .. 1/2; 120 BPM until coop exports the tempo), green click hold (a latch), white click the head pattern (3, 2+3, 1+2+3, 1+3).
